title: FileNode/copy: undo an onExists replace when the copy then fails
description: Found in spec-sync batch 2. In FileNode/copy an onExists 'replace' destroys the existing node before copy_object/copy_subtree; if the copy then fails the replaced node and its subtree stay destroyed, against -20 §3.2.4 'succeeds or fails as a whole'. Documented in the README and copy_subtree docs as a known gap. Needs the replace deferred until the copy succeeds, or a backend-level atomic replace hook (callers implement atomicity, per the reference-impl rule).
